declarations.name: AuiDrawer
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI Drawer; the projected content is the body:
`<aui-drawer title="Filters" [(open)]="filtersOpen">...</aui-drawer>`.
`modal` is read once at creation (init-only).

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Accessible name, rendered as the heading.

inputs.name: actions
inputs.description: Footer buttons; clicking closes with the action value.

inputs.name: modal
inputs.description: true: showModal() with inert background, backdrop and scroll lock. false: show(); background stays interactive (supplementary panels only).

inputs.name: placement
inputs.description: Screen edge; start/end follow the writing direction.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Inline size for side drawers; maximum block size (capped at 85dvh) for top/bottom.

inputs.name: closeOnEscape
inputs.description: Escape requests close (cancelable) when the drawer is the topmost overlay.

inputs.name: closeOnBackdrop
inputs.description: Backdrop click requests close (cancelable). Modal only.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Maps start/end placement to a physical edge; applied as the element's dir.

models.name: open
models.description: Whether the drawer is shown: `[(open)]`. Closing by Escape, the close button, or an action sets it to false.

outputs.name: cancelled
outputs.description: Before a user-initiated close; preventDefault keeps it open.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Dialog (Modal) pattern implemented with native <dialog>.showModal(); non-modal drawers use <dialog>.show() as a non-modal dialog.

limitations: Non-modal drawers are not in the top layer; they use z-index 1000 and can be covered by page content with a higher stacking context.
The element's dir attribute follows the configured direction (default 'ltr'), not the document's dir attribute.
Slide animations need @starting-style and transition-behavior: allow-discrete; older browsers open and close without animation.
Initial focus follows the native dialog focusing steps: an action with `autofocus: true`, otherwise the first focusable element (the close button when shown).
